title: All reports of a manager
prompt: Using a recursive CTE, return the names of all employees who report to Alice (id 1), directly or indirectly (not including Alice herself).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE org (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO org VALUES (1,'Alice',NULL),(2,'Bob',1),(3,'Carol',1),(4,'Dave',2),(5,'Eve',4),(6,'Frank',3);
reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE reports(id, name) AS (SELECT id, name FROM org WHERE manager_id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.name FROM org o JOIN reports r ON o.manager_id = r.id) SELECT name FROM reports;
